title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28
source: Source: Soundboard > Master-Reel > Reel (1st gen) > DAT (48k)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording is clear overall but marred by noticeably off‑key Donna Jean vocals; the concert is fondly remembered by the reviewer.
ai_review.review: The fan notes that the show was memorable (they were in the audience) and praises the pre‑show soundcheck, but complains that Donna Jean’s voice sits out of key and sounds detached from the mix. The FLAC soundboard source is generally clean, yet the vocal balance issue detracts from an otherwise enjoyable nostalgic performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; reviewer gave 4 stars despite vocal issues, indicating a generally positive but qualified view.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound, but Donna Jean’s vocals are out of key and sit oddly in the mix, likely due to monitor problems.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer highlights overall nostalgia rather than song‑by‑song performance.
